cadence_semantics.note: epoch-hour anchoring: 168h/96h/72h blocks are exact multiples of 24h, so on midnight-UTC 1d bars every block boundary is a decision bar; the residual gap vs theory comes from the LIVE-parity completeness gate (a streamed observation symbol missing a closed bar at the decision timestamp skips that decision)

band_analysis.note: decisions = period starts (band NOT applied); orders = distinct client_order_ids in fills (every crypto order fills next bar, so == orders created); fills = decision-driven fills (liquidation is cost-only, no synthetic fill); trades = closed position events

capital_utilization.note: daily exposure = sum(position qty x day close) / equity curve, reconstructed from fills + 1d closes (engine parity); near-max = exposure >= 0.09 of the 0.10 sleeve; idle = fully in cash

churn.methodology: fill-level round trip = any SELL fill of S followed by a BUY fill of S within 7 days (spec definition; contaminated by the 10% participation-cap drip fills); position-level round trip = completed position of S closed and a new position of S opened within 7 days (economic reversal); A->B->A flip = compressed decision-target pair sequence {A,X}->{B,X}->{A,X} with a single-symbol swap (band may suppress the order for a flip; decision-level avoids participation-cap drip transients); reversal cost = fills of S in the exit/rebuy windows; flip cost = unique A/B fills between the two swap decisions + 7 days; costs include slippage+spread+fee

concentration.jackknife_note: symbol jackknife is DEGENERATE here: BTC/USD and ETH/USD are PINNED pool members (config universe.crypto.pinned_symbols) and are the structural low-variance parking spots, so dropping them changes the pinned observation set itself and needs a rebuilt universe — contrary to the mission's build-universe-once requirement. Baseline 168h jackknife already exists in strategy_validation_v4/candidate_B.json (drop-XRP +4.06%, drop-ETH +2.68%, drop-BTC -1.96%). Not re-run per cadence.
